desc: Characterize deletions as a non-crossing matching; prove that when N is odd the single remaining element splits the array so every pair lies entirely on one side, forcing survivor positions to be odd (1-indexed).
Prove for any even multiset that max total |a−b| over non-crossing perfect matchings equals (sum of larger half − sum of smaller half).
Implement even-N case: sort and output sum(largest N/2) − sum(smallest N/2).
Implement two-heap running lower/upper half-sums; compute prefixVal[i] for every even prefix and suffixVal[i] for every even suffix in O(N log N).
Implement odd-N case: maximize prefixVal[p-1] + suffixVal[p+1] over odd p (handle empty prefix/suffix as 0) and print the max.
Validate against samples 1-3 (all pass), N=2, all-equal arrays, and random small brute-force comparisons.
